images.scene: On a bare concrete floor against the plain plaster wall: ONE old hammer lying flat on its side, horizontal, small in the lower third of the frame. Its wooden handle is dark and polished smooth exactly where a hand grips it for years, rough and pale on the rest. Nothing else. Hard low side light, long shadow.

On a bare concrete floor against the plain plaster wall: ONE old hoe (enxada) lying flat, horizontal, the long wooden handle crossing the lower third of the frame, iron blade at one end. The handle is dark and worn glossy only where hands gripped it for years, pale and rough everywhere else. Nothing else. Hard low side light, long shadow.

On a bare concrete floor against the plain plaster wall: ONE pair of old leather work gloves, dropped palms-up, small in the lower third of the frame. The palms and fingertips are dark, cracked and worn thin from years of gripping; the backs of the gloves still look almost new. Nothing else. Hard low side light, long shadows.

On a bare concrete floor against the plain plaster wall: ONE short wooden stool with four legs, old and simple, one leg mended with tight wire wrapped around a split. The stool is small, in the lower half of the frame, well below the middle. Nothing else. Hard low side light, long shadow.

On a bare concrete floor against the plain plaster wall: ONE thick old sisal rope, coiled loosely on the floor, with a single tight knot in it, the fibers around the knot frayed and darkened from having held weight. Small, in the lower third of the frame. Nothing else. Hard low side light, long shadow.

On a bare concrete floor against the plain plaster wall: ONE old iron weight plate (a barbell disc), rusty and worn smooth around the center hole where it was handled for years, lying flat on the floor, small in the lower third of the frame. Nothing else. Hard low side light, long shadow.

On a bare concrete floor against the plain plaster wall: ONE single old stone step, a worn block of granite whose top surface is hollowed into a shallow dip exactly in the middle from decades of feet, untouched and sharp at the edges. It sits low, in the lower third of the frame. Nothing else. Hard low side light.

On a bare concrete floor, leaning against the plain plaster wall, a short old punching bag, dark worn leather, cracked and faded only in one band at chest height where it was hit for years, the rest of the leather intact. The bag is short and sits on the floor, its top well below the middle of the frame, nothing hanging from above. Nothing else. Hard low side light, long shadow.

On a bare wooden table against the plain plaster wall, seen at table level: ONE adult worker's hand resting on the table palm up, relaxed, fingers slightly curled, with thick hard calluses only at the base of the fingers and the pad below the thumb, the rest of the palm smooth and soft. Only the hand and the wrist are visible, entering from the right edge, low in the frame, well below the middle. Realistic anatomy, five fingers. Hard low side light.

On a bare concrete floor against the plain plaster wall: TWO identical low wooden stools side by side. The left stool carries three heavy sacks of cement stacked on it, legs holding firm; the right stool is empty. The stack stays low, its top well below the middle of the frame. Nothing else. Hard low side light, long shadows.

On a bare concrete floor against the plain plaster wall: TWO coils of thick sisal rope side by side. The left one is brand new, pale, tightly coiled, still with a paper tag; the right one is dark, frayed, with a tight knot that has clearly held weight. Both small, in the lower third of the frame. Nothing else. Hard low side light, long shadows.

On a bare concrete floor against the plain plaster wall: TWO identical old wooden kitchen chairs side by side. On the left chair sit two heavy sacks of cement, the chair holding firm; the right chair is empty. Chairs seen from the front at floor level, their backs ending well below the middle of the frame. Nothing else. Hard low side light, long shadows.

On a bare concrete floor against the plain plaster wall: ONE broken-off foot of an ancient Greek marble statue, life size, lying on its side so the bare heel faces the camera, classical sculpted anatomy, chipped and weathered, the heel catching the light. On a bare concrete floor against the plain plaster wall: a close view of ONE adult bare foot standing on tiptoe, seen from behind and slightly from the side, so the raised heel is the center of the image; only the foot and the lower ankle are visible, entering from the bottom edge, well below the middle of the frame.
